description: This file defines the 'EditorPage' React component for a blog post editor with real-time features, auto-saving, publishing, and deletion. It interfaces with hooks and utilities for post management, content editing via tiptap, and image uploads.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a callback function to limit its execution frequency.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures a post ID exists, creating a new post if necessary, and returns the ID.

methods.name: debouncedSave
methods.description: Automatically saves the post title and content after a debounce period.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Handles image uploads by calling the external uploadImage function.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Updates content state and triggers debounced auto-save.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Updates title state and triggers debounced auto-save.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Performs an explicit save of the current post.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles the publication status of the post, updating slug and publishing accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post after user confirmation.
